confidence_notes: Food and beer anchors come from aggregated cost-of-living data found by web search, mainly Numbeo data from June 2026 republished by Expatica. Those figures were cross-checked against MyLifeElsewhere and Livingcost.org. The mid-range meal for two was adjusted slightly upward from about $65 to allow for prices rising by July 2026. No cocktail or wine prices were searched. Those two figures come from general knowledge of US bar pricing and their usual relationship to beer prices, so they are less certain. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July, which is hot summer off-peak to shoulder season in San Antonio. They do not come from booking searches. The city has very few registered hostels, so the dorm bed and private room figures are especially uncertain. The FX rate is the RBA observation for 18 November 2026 as reported in search results. A later intraday move below 0.67 was not an RBA fix.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink prices are anchored to San Antonio-specific aggregated data. Accommodation is compared with other large Texas and US Sun Belt cities such as Austin and Houston, adjusted down because San Antonio is generally more affordable than Austin.
